known_limitations.description: Beaconing and DNS tunneling are not e2e-verified; synthetic scoring and state tests do not establish golden-PCAP detection. Exfiltration maps only to tactic TA0010, omitted from attack_techniques.
Measured quality is computed by services/feedback-service/quality.py (KTD2); static confidence weights are not measured precision or false-positive rates.

Beaconing is scored first by outlier-robust interval statistics and, only when those do not fire, by a jitter/gap-tolerant autocorrelation fallback emitted under the SAME beacon detector_id (ADR 014). Autocorrelation recovers a dominant period; it does not prove C2, and it is NOT a general solution to heavy jitter — per-sleep randomisation random-walks the beacon phase, so around +/-50% per-interval jitter the correlation peak decays with it. Constant payload sizes cannot establish a period: raw timing strength is gated separately.

Exfil bytes, connection counts and cumulative long-connection seconds are DERIVED by summing per-flow cumulative values keyed by flow identity, not accumulated (ADR 015), so replay and repeated cumulative interim flow records are idempotent. This is idempotency, not exactly-once delivery. Per-pair flow identities are capped (NDR_FLOW_IDENTITY_CAP); when the cap binds the aggregate is a FLOOR and the refused-write count is carried on the finding, never dropped silently.
